blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Hybrid solid-state LiDAR sensors are making their way into production vehicles, yet the data they produce differs structurally from that of the established spinning mechanical sensors behind today's autonomous-driving datasets: it is ring-free, dense, cluttered, and concentrated in a frontal field of view. The classical geometric methods that autonomous vehicles rely on for drivable space computation and navigation assume the ordered ring-and-column structure of a 360-degree spinning LiDAR and degrade or fail on this data, while learned alternatives are computationally heavy, hard to certify, and trained almost exclusively on spinning-LiDAR data. We demonstrate that the same dense, per-curve geometry is instead an opportunity to close the divide between the industry's preferred sensors and autonomous-driving research. We present GHySSeg, a purely geometric method that segments ground and drivable road from a single hybrid solid-state LiDAR frame by tracing each scan curve and reading two geometric signatures, a step in height and a fold-back in range, with no training and no graphics processing unit. To evaluate it, we release HySoLiD-Drive, the first public benchmark dedicated to ground and road segmentation on an automotive hybrid solid-state LiDAR, comprising 100 manually labeled and 7000 unlabeled frames recorded by two vehicles in real driving. On this benchmark, GHySSeg surpasses both geometric and learned state-of-the-art baselines across ground and road segmentation, reaching an intersection-over-union of 0.907 for road and 0.896 for ground at over 0.96 precision, while running in real time at about 22 milliseconds per frame on a single core.
blocks.zh: 混合固态LiDAR传感器正在进入生产载体,然而它们所产生的数据在结构上与今天自主驾驶数据集背后的既有旋转机械传感器不同:它是无环状的,密集的,杂乱无章的,并集中在前视场. 自主飞行器在可驾驶空间计算和导航时所依赖的经典几何方法假设360度旋转LiDAR所订购的环相并列结构,并在此数据上降解或失败,而所学的替代品则在计算上很重,难以验证,并且几乎专门对旋转-LiDAR数据进行培训. 我们证明,同样的密密的每曲线几何是缩小该行业偏好传感器与自主驾驶研究之间鸿沟的机会。 我们提出的GHySSeg是一种纯粹的几何方法,它通过追踪每个扫描曲线并读取两个几何特征,高一阶和折叠回放范围,从单一混合固态LiDAR框架分出地面和可驾驶的道路,没有训练,也没有图形处理单元. 为了评价它,我们发布了HySoLiD-Drive,这是第一个在汽车混合固态LiDAR上专门用于地上和地上分道扬镳的公共基准,包括100个手动标注和7000个无标注框被两辆车记录在真实驾驶中. 在这个基准上,GHySSeg超越了地上和地上分道通航的几何和最先进的基线,达到0.907路和0.896路相接,精确度超过0.96分,同时在一个单一地心上实时运行,每帧约22毫秒.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: LiDAR (light detection and ranging) is the cornerstone of modern autonomous driving (AD). As an active sensor, it delivers rich three-dimensional (3-D) measurements that stay reliable under poor illumination, even in complete darkness, and that are far denser than those of radar sensors, enabling object detection and classification directly in 3-D for a thorough understanding of the space around the vehicle. Its long range, moreover, lets a vehicle anticipate the road ahead, even at high speed [ 1 ] .
blocks.zh: LiDAR(光探测和测距)是现代自主驾驶(AD)的基石. 作为一种主动传感器,它提供丰富的三维(3-D)测量数据,这些测量数据在光线差的情况下保持可靠,即使在完全黑暗中也是如此,并且比雷达传感器更密集,能够直接用3-D进行物体探测和分类,以便彻底了解飞行器周围的空间. 此外,它的长距离让车辆预见到前面的道路,即使高速[1]。

blocks.en: Spinning mechanical LiDARs, which provide a full 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} field of view (FOV), dominate research: they are a mature, well-understood technology, and the public AD datasets and benchmarks are built almost exclusively on them [ 1 ] . Their adoption in consumer vehicles, however, faces real barriers. They are expensive; exploiting their 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} coverage requires mounting them protruding above the roof, which is neither aerodynamic nor aesthetic and noticeably increases the vehicle’s height clearance; and they rely on moving parts spinning at high speed.

blocks.en: These limitations have already driven a shift in the automotive industry toward solid-state (SS) and hybrid solid-state (HSS) LiDARs. Such sensors sacrifice full 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} coverage in exchange for fewer (or no) moving parts, a higher and more concentrated point density, a cleaner and more seamless installation, and, above all, a lower cost [ 2 ] . Recent consumer vehicle models, led predominantly by Chinese manufacturers such as Xiaomi, BYD, and NIO, with Western manufacturers such as Mercedes-Benz now following, already integrate SS or HSS LiDARs [ 3 , 4 ] , bringing LiDAR to mass-production vehicles at last, beyond research platforms and robotaxis.
blocks.zh: 这些限制已经促使汽车工业向固态(SS)和混合固态(HSS)LiDARs(HSS)转变。 这些传感器牺牲了完整的360 — — 360 — — 360 — — Circ 覆盖,以换取更少(或不)的移动部件、更高和更集中的点密度、更清洁、更无缝的安装,以及最重要的是更低的成本[2]。 近代消费车辆型号主要由中国小米,BYD,NIO等制造商主导,梅赛德斯-奔驰等西方制造商现在也紧随其后,已经整合了SS或HSS LiDARs[3,4],最终将LiDAR引入了大众生产车辆,超出了研究平台和机器人轴.

blocks.en: This new technology, however, brings a challenge of its own: the data it produces is structurally different from that of a spinning sensor, as depicted in Fig. 2 . HSS point clouds lack the structured ring pattern and the neatly ordered azimuth columns that spinning LiDARs owe to their rotating laser array, and, because the field of view is condensed into a frontal region, they are far denser and considerably less organized.

blocks.en: When facing this seemingly disorganized data, the classical geometric methods that autonomous vehicles rely on for perception, scene-understanding, and path-planning, such as ground filtering, drivable-area and road segmentation, and free-space estimation, degrade or fail outright, because they depend on the ordered ring-and-column structure of a spinning sensor. With the growing diversity of LiDAR manufacturers and models, the field’s dominant answer is learned semantic segmentation [ 5 , 6 ] , in which a neural network labels every point directly from the raw cloud. These models, however, require a graphics processing unit (GPU) for inference that adds cost and energy demand, they behave unpredictably in unseen scenarios, offer little traceability of their errors, and, most importantly, they are trained almost exclusively on spinning-LiDAR datasets such as KITTI [ 7 , 8 ] . This introduces a domain gap: a model trained on cleanly spaced 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} data struggles to generalize to the denser, frontal, more cluttered clouds of a solid-state sensor, even though both are 3-D point clouds [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 当面对这种看似混乱的数据时,自主载体依赖于感知,场景理解和路径规划的经典几何方法,如地面滤波,可驾驶区和道路分割,以及自由空间估计,完全降解或失败,因为它们依赖于旋转传感器的定点环形和柱形结构. 随着LiDAR厂商和模型的日益多样化,球场的主要答案是学习语义分解[5,6],其中神经网络直接从生云中标注每个点. 然而,这些模型需要一个图形处理单元(GPU)来推论,增加成本和能量需求,在隐形情景中表现不可预测,对其错误几乎没有可追溯性,而且最重要的是,它们几乎完全接受诸如KITTI[7,8]等旋转-LiDAR数据集的培训。 这引入了一个域间隙:一个接受过清洁空间训练的模型 360 QQ 360 ^{\circ} 数据挣扎着向一个固态传感器的更密集,正面,更杂乱的云进行概括,尽管两者都是3-D点云[9].

blocks.en: Yet the very properties that break these methods are also an opportunity. The high density, the focused FOV, and the close, non-ring scan lines let an HSS sensor resolve surfaces, curbs, and centimetric steps sharply. In this dense per-curve structure, road boundaries leave a clean geometric signature: a step in height together with a visible bend in the range profile.
blocks.zh: 然而,打破这些方法的特性本身也是一个机会。 高密度,聚焦的FOV,以及近非环形扫描线使得一个HSS传感器能快速地解决表面,抑制,以及厘米级的阶梯. 在这种密密的每曲线结构中,道路边界留下了干净的几何特征:高的一步加上射程剖面的可见弯曲.

blocks.en: This article turns that observation into a method. We propose GHySSeg (Fig. 1 ), which exploits the specific characteristics of automotive HSS LiDAR data to segment ground and road by pure geometry, without training or running heavy models, without a GPU, and in real time on a consumer-grade CPU, providing reliable and fast drivable-area 3-D detection for demanding autonomous-driving applications.
blocks.zh: 本条将观察变成一种方法。 我们提出GHySSeg(图1),它利用汽车HSS LiDAR数据的具体特性,通过纯几何来分割地面和道路,不经过训练或运行重型模型,没有GPU,实时在消费级CPU上,为要求自主驾驶的应用提供可靠和快速的可驾驶区域3-D检测.

blocks.en: Because no existing public benchmark specifically targets ground and road segmentation on an automotive hybrid solid-state LiDAR as the main sensor, GHySSeg has been developed and validated on an Innovusion (now Seyond) Falcon Kinetic LiDAR [ 10 ] mounted on two distinct autonomous vehicles operated by our laboratory at the Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M). Moreover, to directly address this automotive hybrid solid-state LiDAR data scarcity, we release HySoLiD-Drive [ 11 ] as part of this work. HySoLiD-Drive is an open benchmark of 100 unique, manually per-point-labeled frames, spanning urban roads, motorways, roundabouts, dense traffic, and sharp turns, together with 7000 unlabeled frames drawn from two continuous drives through Madrid, Spain. It comprises the data we have used to evaluate GHySSeg, and invites the community to build on it and benchmark against our results through an open, transparent leaderboard.
blocks.zh: 由于没有现有的公共基准专门将地面和道路分割作为汽车混合固态LiDAR的主要传感器,因此GHySSeg已经开发并验证了安装在我们马德里卡洛斯三世大学(UC3M)实验室运行的两辆独立自主车辆上的Falcon Kinetic LiDAR(现为Seyond)创新型机车。 此外,为了直接解决这种汽车混合固态LiDAR数据稀缺的问题,我们发布了HySoLiD-Drive [11],作为这项工作的一部分. HySoLiD-Drive是一个开放的基准,由100个独特的,人工的每个点标记的帧组成,横跨城市道路,高速公路,环路,密集的交通,以及尖锐的转弯,同时还有7000个无标记的帧从两个连续的驱动器中抽取,经过西班牙马德里. 它包含我们用来评价GHySSeg的数据,并请社区通过一个公开、透明的领导板,在此基础上并参照我们的成果。

blocks.en: The contributions of this work are the following. • A sensor-native, real-time, single-shot, geometry-only ground and road segmentation method for HSS LiDAR. • A per-curve road-boundary formulation that exploits the density and geometry of HSS data through height-step and range-fold-back signatures. • HySoLiD-Drive, the first public benchmark dedicated to ground and road segmentation on an automotive hybrid solid-state LiDAR in real-world driving scenes, released with an open leaderboard. • A real-world evaluation against six baselines with cross-vehicle transfer, displaying state-of-the-art accuracy at real-time CPU cost.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Ground and road segmentation are long-standing prerequisites for LiDAR perception within the autonomous driving field. In classical modular pipelines, they form the first stage, feeding everything in the AD stack from free-space estimation and real-time mapping to occupancy-grid construction and reactive obstacle detection [ 12 ] . Two schools of thought address them: geometric, heuristic methods and learned, machine-learning (ML) approaches. Their balance is task-dependent: on ground segmentation the two remain closely matched on public benchmarks, whereas on road segmentation the learned school clearly dominates. We therefore review and benchmark both schools on each task.
blocks.zh: 地面和道路分割是自主驾驶场内LiDAR感知的长期先决条件. 在古典模块化管道中,它们构成了第一阶段,将AD堆栈中的所有东西从空闲空间估计和实时映射到占用-网格建设和反应障碍探测[12]. 两种思想流派对它们进行探讨:几何学派、热力学派和学习派、机器学派。 两者的平衡取决于任务:在地面划分方面,两者在公共基准上保持密切匹配,而在道路划分方面,学识丰富的学校显然占主导地位。 因此,我们审查和衡量两所学校的每项任务。

blocks.en: II-A Geometric Ground Segmentation
blocks.zh: II-A 几何地面分区

blocks.en: Ground segmentation is the first stage of most non-ML LiDAR-centered perception pipelines: quickly discarding the measurements that belong to the ground is what makes the subsequent clustering and object detection possible and robust. Its classical solutions are purely geometric. Early methods fit a single ground plane by random sample consensus (RANSAC) or least squares, or discretize the scan into a polar or Cartesian elevation grid and threshold the local height [ 13 ] . To handle non-planar terrain, approaches such as that of Zermas et al. divide the cloud into radial bins and, for each bin, estimate the shape of the ground by fitting several connected straight-line segments extending away from the sensor [ 14 ] . Widely adopted open autonomous-driving stacks follow the same principle; Autoware, for instance, ships a ray-ground filter that walks each radial ray outward from the vehicle and labels points as ground from their height and angle [ 15 ] . More recent work improves robustness on sloped and uneven ground: Patchwork [ 16 ] and its successor Patchwork++ [ 17 ] divide the scan into concentric zones, tailored to the ring structure of a spinning LiDAR, and fit a region-wise plane in each. Patchwork++ is one of the most widely adopted real-time geometric methods, reporting a ground-segmentation F1 score above 96% on SemanticKITTI. A different geometric strategy is the cloth simulation filter (CSF) [ 18 ] , which drapes a virtual cloth over the inverted cloud to separate ground from non-ground; originally developed for airborne and mapping LiDAR, it is robust but comparatively slow. Some recent methods even hybridize the two schools, pairing a geometric polar partitioning with a sparse convolutional network that resolves only the ambiguous, data-sparse regions [ 19 ] . These geometric methods were designed for spinning sensors: their radial bins, concentric zones, and elevation grids all assume the ordered ring-and-azimuth sampling of a rotating LiDAR. Moreover, their limited precision at small elevations such as curbs confines them to the ground surface rather than the drivable road. Recent work has begun adapting geometric ground segmentation to solid-state sensors, though only for hardware acceleration and for ground alone [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 地面分割是大多数非ML LiDAR 中心感知管道的第一阶段: 迅速丢弃属于地面的测量,是使得后续的集群和物体探测成为可能和坚固的. 它的古典解决方案纯粹是几何化的. 早期的方法通过随机抽样共识(RANSAC)或最小方块与单一地面平面相匹配,或者将扫描成极地或笛卡尔海拔网格并阈值当地高度[13]. 为了处理非平面地形,如Zermas等人的接近。 将云分为射线箱,对于每个箱,通过安装若干连接的直线段来估计地面的形状,这些段延伸至传感器之外[14]。 广泛采用的开放式自动驱动堆栈遵循同样的原则; 例如,Autoware 运载一个射线地面滤波器,将每个射线从车辆向外行走,并从高度和角度将标记点作为地面[15]。 近期的工作提高了坡度和不均衡地的稳健性: 补丁工作 [16] 及其后续的补丁工作++ [17] 将扫描分成同心区,根据旋转的LiDAR的环状结构量身定制,并在每个区间安装一个区域级平面. 补丁工作++是最广泛采用的实时几何方法之一,在SemanticKITTI上报告地面分数F1的得分高于96%. 一种不同的几何策略是布料模拟滤波器(CSF)[18],它将一个虚拟布铺在倒云上,将地面与非地面分开;最初是为空中和绘图LiDAR而开发的,它坚固但相对缓慢. 近代的一些方法甚至将两派混为一谈,将几何极分化与一个稀疏的演化网络配对起来,只解决模棱两可,数据分散的区域[19]. 这些几何方法是为了旋转传感器而设计的:它们的光圈箱、同心区和高架网格都假定旋转的LiDAR有顺序的环状和角状取样。 此外,它们在小海拔(如弯道)的精度有限,使其限于地面,而不是可驾驶的道路。 近期的工作已经开始将几何地面分区调整为固态传感器,不过仅用于硬件加速度和仅用于地面[20].

blocks.en: II-B Learned Point-Cloud Semantic Segmentation
blocks.zh: II-B 吸取教训的Cloud语义分区

blocks.en: Data-driven semantic segmentation, in contrast, can label ground and road either separately or jointly, and it has spread rapidly within the autonomous driving community thanks to its ability to adapt to different sensors and scenarios. In these methods, a neural network assigns a class to every point from previously trained weights [ 5 , 6 ] . Projection-based methods first convert the cloud into a range image and apply 2-D convolutions for real-time inference, as in RangeNet++ [ 21 ] and SalsaNext [ 22 ] . Point- and voxel-based networks instead operate on the 3-D structure directly: RandLA-Net [ 23 ] samples large clouds efficiently, and Cylinder3D [ 24 ] applies sparse convolutions over a cylindrical partition. More recent architectures move beyond sparse convolution: WaffleIron [ 25 ] shows that competitive accuracy is achievable with a backbone built almost entirely from multilayer perceptrons and dense 2-D convolutions, while Point Transformer V3 [ 26 ] uses attention on large point clouds and defines the current state of the art on major outdoor benchmarks. A more recent transformer, RWAFormer [ 27 ] , keeps this attention-based design but specializes it for road segmentation, yielding a lighter model. Some learned models specialize in ground estimation alone: GndNet [ 28 ] regresses a dense ground-elevation grid with a pillar-based network and labels points against it in real time. Despite their accuracy and dominance over the field, these networks share three costs that are very relevant on a production vehicle: they require a GPU, their decisions are hard to trace or certify [ 29 ] , and, most important here, they are trained almost exclusively on spinning-LiDAR datasets such as SemanticKITTI [ 8 ] . Applied to a hybrid solid-state sensor without retraining, they face a domain gap that our experiments quantify.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,数据驱动的语义分解可以分别或联合标注地面和道路,由于能够适应不同的传感器和情景,它已经在自主驱动社区中迅速扩散. 在这些方法中,神经网络从以前训练过的重量[5,6]的每个点分配一个班. 基于投影的方法首先将云转换成范围图像,并应用二维折射法进行实时推论,如RangeNet++ [21]和SalsaNext [22]. 而以点和伏克塞尔为基础的网络则直接在三维结构上运行: RandLA-Net [23] 高效地样本大云,Cylinder3D [24] 在一个圆柱形的分割上应用了稀疏的曲折. 较近期的建筑超越了稀疏的演化:WaffleIron [25] 显示,通过几乎完全由多层感官和密集的二维进化而建的骨干可以实现竞争的精度,而Point Transformer V3 [26] 则在大点云上使用注意力,并在主要室外基准上定义了艺术的现状. 较近期的变压器RWAFormer [27],保持这种基于注意力的设计,但专门用于道路分割,产生更轻的模型. 一些有学问的模型专门从事地面估计:GndNet[28] 将密集的地面线网与基于界桩的网络递减,并实时贴出与之相对的标签. 尽管这些网络的准确性和对现场的支配性,但它们分担了与生产车辆非常相关的三个成本:它们需要GPU,它们的决定很难追踪或认证[29],而最重要的是,它们几乎完全接受诸如SemanticKITTI[8]等旋转-LiDAR数据集的培训。 被应用到混合固态传感器上 而无需再培训, 它们面临一个域间隙, 我们的实验量化。

blocks.en: II-C Geometric Road and Curb Detection
blocks.zh: II-C 几何道路和曲线探测

blocks.en: On a much smaller scale, a few methods segment the road geometrically rather than the ground, usually by detecting curbs as the physical boundary of the drivable area. Because a curb produces a small but sharp rise in height, it can be localized geometrically. Horváth et al. [ 30 ] detect urban road and sidewalk boundaries in real time by scanning each sensor channel for the height and angular discontinuities that mark a curb, and Zhang et al. [ 31 ] first segment the road with a sliding-beam method and then locate the curbs within each segment. More recent geometric systems continue this line: Wei et al. [ 32 ] separate the drivable area on structured and unstructured roads by thresholding point-wise features (surface normals, curvature, and intensity) selected through an information-gain analysis. Such works show that geometric road segmentation is both feasible and fast. However, built for conventional spinning LiDAR, these methods rely on its ordered beam geometry, and its sparse rings resolve a low curb only close to the sensor. On a hybrid solid-state sensor this ring structure is absent, but its high density resolves the same curb far out across the frontal field, the very property this work exploits, and one otherwise unaddressed for this class of sensor.
blocks.zh: 在更小的尺度上,有几种方法将道路几何而不是地面分割开来,通常通过探测弯曲作为可驾驶区域的物理边界. 由于一股弯道产生小但尖锐的高度上升,因此可以局部几何. Horváth等 (英语). [30] 实时检测城市道路和人行道边界,通过扫描每个感应通道的高度和角断层,标出一个路段,张等. [31] 第一段路段采用滑梁法,然后在每个路段内定位路边. 最近的几何系统继续这条线: 魏等编. [32] 在结构化和非结构化的公路上通过通过信息获取分析选定的临界点特征(表面正常、曲率和强度)将可驾驶区分开。 这些作品表明几何路段既可行又快捷. 然而,为常规旋转的LiDAR而建造,这些方法依赖于其订购的光束几何,其稀疏的环能解决仅接近传感器的低路面. 在混合固态传感器上,这个环状结构是不存在的, 但其高密度在远处的前沿领域解决了同样的阻力, 也就是这个工作利用的属性, 以及这一类传感器未解决的特性。

blocks.en: II-D Public LiDAR Datasets and Benchmarks for Ground and Road Segmentation
blocks.zh: II-D 公共图书馆 地面和道路划分数据集和基准

blocks.en: Beyond methods, there is also a second gap in the available data itself that explains the scarcity of ground and road segmentation solutions for hybrid solid-state sensors: the established and widespread autonomous-driving benchmarks on which LiDAR perception research is largely based (SemanticKITTI [ 8 ] , nuScenes [ 33 ] , and the Waymo Open Dataset [ 34 ] ) provide extensive per-point semantic labels for their LiDAR data, ground and road among them, over thousands of real driving scenes. Every one of these benchmarks, however, uses spinning mechanical LiDARs, so the regularly spaced ring-and-azimuth structure they capture is precisely what a hybrid solid-state sensor lacks. Therefore, by definition, they cannot be used to develop or evaluate a method built for HSS data.
blocks.zh: 除了方法之外,现有数据本身还存在第二个空白,这解释了混合固态传感器地面和道路分解解决方案的稀缺性:LiDAR感知研究主要依据的既定和广泛的自主驾驶基准(SemanticKITTI [8],nuScens [33],Waymo Open Dataset [34])为其LiDAR数据,地面和道路提供了广泛的每个点的语义标签,其中超过数千个真正的驱动场景. 然而,这些基准中的每一个都使用旋转机械的LiDARs,所以它们所捕获的固定间距的环状和亚齐结构正是混合固态传感器所缺乏的. 因此,顾名思义,它们不能被用来开发或评价为HSS数据构建的方法.

blocks.en: A few solid-state and hybrid solid-state datasets have recently appeared, bringing the right sensor but not the right task or focus. PandaSet [ 35 ] is the one that comes closest: it pairs a spinning Pandar64 LiDAR with a forward-facing hybrid solid-state PandarGT and it provides semantic-segmentation labels, a drivable-surface class included. Its hybrid solid-state unit, however, is auxiliary to the mechanical one in the dataset, and PandaSet is a broad general-purpose semantic-segmentation dataset, with no standard split or leaderboard, rather than a benchmark dedicated to the drivable road or hybrid solid-state technology. From the remaining public HSS and SS datasets none targets ground and road segmentation in real-world driving: SimoSet [ 36 ] records automotive hybrid solid-state data, yet only for object detection, with no ground or road labels; S.MID [ 37 ] provides hybrid solid-state (Livox Mid-360) semantic segmentation in industrial substations rather than on the road; and i2Nav-Robot [ 38 ] mounts a hybrid solid-state LiDAR (Hesai AT128) on a small mobile robot for multi-sensor navigation, but without ground or road labels. Even the most recent datasets fall short: LiDARDustX [ 39 ] includes a Seyond Falcon among its six LiDAR sensors and does have ground labels, yet it targets dusty off-road environments such as mines and sand quarries and provides no drivable-road class. Hence, none combines a hybrid solid-state sensor, real driving scenarios, a public benchmark, and ground-and-road semantic labels. The complete landscape has been captured in Table I .
blocks.zh: 最近出现了一些固态和混合固态数据集,带来了正确的传感器,但没有正确的任务或焦点. PandaSet [35] 是最接近的:它将旋转的Pandar64 LiDAR与前方的混合固态PandarGT配对,它提供语义分解标签,包括可驾驶的表面类. 然而,它的混合固态单元是数据集中机械单元的辅助,而PandaSet是一个广义的通用语义分解数据集,没有标准分块或主板,而不是一个专门用于可驱动道路或混合固态技术的基准. 在其余的公共HSS和SS数据集中,没有任何一个针对地面和道路在现实世界中行驶: SimoSet [36]记录了汽车混合固态数据,然而仅用于物体探测,没有地面或道路标签;S.MID [37]在工业分站而不是在道路上提供混合固态(Livox Mid-360)语义分区;i2Nav-Robot [38]在小型移动机器人上搭载混合固态LiDAR(Hesai AT128)进行多传感器导航,但没有地面或道路标签. 甚至最近的数据集也不足:LiDARDustX[39]在其6个LiDAR传感器中包括了一只Seyond Falcon,并且确实有地面标签,然而它针对的是矿山和砂石等尘土化的路外环境,没有可驾驶的路级. 因此,没有人会将混合固态传感器、真正的驱动情景、公共基准和地面和道路语义标签结合起来。 表一中记录了完整的景观。

blocks.en: Two gaps therefore motivate this work. First, geometric segmentation of ground and road has not been addressed natively for hybrid solid-state data: existing geometric approaches either stop at the ground or assume the ring-and-azimuth structure that these sensors lack, whereas the learned alternatives are heavy, opaque, and trained on other sensor types. Second, as captured in Table I , no public benchmark dedicated to ground and drivable-road segmentation in real-world driving scenarios is centered around an automotive hybrid solid-state LiDAR. The established and renowned driving benchmarks all use mechanical LiDARs as their only or primary (in the case of PandaSet) sensor, and the existing datasets centered on hybrid solid-state are either detection-only, off-road, or not focused on cars but on compact mobile robots or industrial applications. This work closes both gaps at once with GHySSeg, the first native geometric ground-and-road segmentation method for hybrid solid-state LiDAR, and HySoLiD-Drive, to our knowledge, the first public benchmark dedicated to ground and road segmentation on an automotive hybrid solid-state LiDAR in real-world driving.
blocks.zh: 因此,有两个差距推动了这项工作。 首先,地面和道路的几何分解尚未因混合固态数据而本土解决:现有的几何方法要么停留在地面上,要么假定这些传感器缺乏的环状和环状结构,而学到的替代品则很重、不透明,并受过其他传感器类型的培训。 第二,如表一所示,在现实世界的驾驶情景中,没有专门针对地面和可驾驶道路分割的公共基准以汽车混合固态LiDAR为中心。 既定和著名的驾驶基准都使用机械LiDARs作为其唯一的或初级的(就PandaSet而言)传感器,而以混合固态为中心的现有数据集要么是只探测的,在路外的,要么不是专注于汽车,而是紧凑的移动机器人或工业应用. 这项工作同时填补了GHySSeg和HySoLiD-Drive的两处空白,前者是混合固态LiDAR的首个本土几何地与道路分割方法,后者是据我们所知,是汽车混合固态LiDAR在现实世界驱动中用于地面与道路分割的第一个公共基准。

blocks.en: III-A Exploiting Hybrid Solid-State LiDAR Data: From Rings to Curves
blocks.zh: 三-A 开发混合固体国家 数据 : 从环到曲线

blocks.en: The proposed method segments each point of a raw hybrid solid-state LiDAR point cloud, in real time and by pure geometry, into ground, drivable road, and obstacles, exploiting the sensor’s ray distribution, front-facing nature, and high 3-D density. That density is the key enabler: where a spinning LiDAR, with its sparse and widely spaced rings, may confuse a curb with sensor noise or with the road’s natural camber, an HSS sensor places dozens of points on either side of that curb (and often on its very face) so that even a centimetric rise in height remains identifiable at long range.
blocks.zh: 拟议的方法将原始混合固态LiDAR点云的每个点,在实时和纯几何方式下,分为地面、可驾驶道路和障碍物,利用传感器的射线分布、前立面性质和高三维密度。 这种密度是关键促成因素:旋转的LiDAR, 其空间狭小的环, 可能会混淆一个弯曲与传感器噪音或路边的自然凸轮,

blocks.en: Hybrid solid-state LiDARs are not entirely free of moving parts. They steer their beams in several ways, using micro-electro-mechanical system (MEMS) mirrors, rotating prisms, or polygonal and galvanometer mirrors, among others [ 1 , 2 ] . Our method does not assume any particular steering technology; it relies only on two properties that these designs share: a high point density concentrated in a front-facing field of view, and a scan pattern that departs from sparse, cleanly spaced 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} rings. That scan pattern gives a loose notion of order: successive sweeps trace concave curves, or pseudo-rings, which may be irregular or even intersecting, yet, being produced by a deterministic physical scan, form a repeatable structure that the method can traverse.
blocks.zh: 混合固态LiDARs并非完全没有移动部件. 它们使用微电机系统镜像、旋转棱镜或多边形和伽微计镜像等,以几种方式引导其束。 我们的方法并不设想任何特定的引导技术;它只依赖于这些设计共享的两个属性:一个高点密度集中在前视场,另一个是扫描模式,它偏离了稀疏,干净的空间360 QQ360 QCirc}环. 这种扫描图案给出了一个松散的顺序概念:连续扫射微量凸轮曲线,或伪环,可能是不规则的甚至交叉的,然而,通过定型物理扫描生成的,形成了一种可重复的结构,方法可以穿透.

blocks.en: Seen from above (Fig. 2b ), the curves look disordered near the sensor: early curves cross and mix at the center of the field of view, yet separate cleanly at range, each taking a concave shape. This geometry naturally yields two clear signatures of the road edge. The first is range-based: where the road ends, the curves bend back toward the sensor, because a rise in height interrupts them; the raw point cloud thus marks the road edge directly, as can be seen in Fig. 2b . The second signature is vertical. A road is physically bounded by elements that rise abruptly from the drivable surface (curbs, guardrails, fences, or walls), each ending the road with a sudden step in height that a 3-D LiDAR resolves directly. Figure 3 plots the height profile along a single scan curve of an HSS LiDAR crossing a four-lane road. We can observe the gentle camber of the road, bounded on both sides by a sharp, easily identifiable step of roughly 0.1 m where the curb rises suddenly.
blocks.zh: 从上面看(图2b),曲线看起来在传感器附近是混乱的:早期曲线在视野的中心交叉和混合,然而在范围上是分开的干净的,每个曲线都有一个凸起的形状. 这种几何自然产生两个明显的路边特征. 第一种是测距法:在道路结束的地方,曲线向传感器弯回,因为高度的上升会打断它们;原点云因此直接标注了道路边缘,在Fig中可以看到. 第2款b项 第二个签名是垂直的. 一条道路由从可驾驶的表面(弯道、护栏、栅栏或墙壁)突起的元素构成,每条道路以3D LiDAR直接解决的突然高程结束。 图3是沿一个HSS LiDAR横跨四车道公路的单一扫描曲线绘制高度图。 我们可以看到路边的温和摄像头,两侧以一个约0.1米的快速、易于辨认的台阶为界,路面突然上升。

blocks.en: Both ground and road segmentation share the same per-curve traversal, processing each individually traversable scan curve and reasoning about the height along it. What separates them is the nature of what each recovers. The ground does not need to be smooth or bounded, so it can be segmented coarsely, by a tolerant region growing outward from the vehicle. The road, in contrast, is a smooth surface with a clearly defined boundary, so it must be delimited finely, following each curve out to the edge its signatures reveal. Coarse or fine, both stages are single-shot: each segments the current scan alone, without temporal accumulation or tracking, so a complete result is available from the very first frame.
blocks.zh: 地面和道路的分割都具有相同的每条纵曲线,分别处理每个可穿越的扫描曲线,并推理其沿途的高度. 将它们分开的是 每种恢复的性质 地面不需要平滑或有界线,因此可以被车体向外生长的宽容区域粗糙地分割. 与此相反,这条道路是一个平滑的表面,有明确划定的边界,因此必须精确划定,沿着每个曲线向外走至其签字所揭示的边缘。 粗细或细细,两个阶段都是单镜头的:每个片段的当前扫描单独进行,没有时间积累或跟踪,所以从第一个帧可以得到完整的结果.

blocks.en: Figure 4 summarizes the complete proposed method. From the raw, aligned point cloud, ground segmentation forms per-curve cells, seeds the near central curves, and grows a flat, height-consistent surface outward in range order; only the points that lie inside this surface are considered ground. These ground points feed road segmentation, which walks each curve outward from the vehicle centerline to the first boundary, propagates seeds across curves, and closes with a cohesion pass that enforces spatial consistency. The result is three per-point labels for the complete point cloud, non-ground (obstacles), ground, and road. These are ready to be consumed by downstream autonomous-driving modules such as occupancy-grid maps, obstacle detection, or navigation. Each stage of the method is described in depth below.
blocks.zh: 图4概述了整个拟议方法。 从原始的,对齐的点云,地面分割形成每曲线的细胞,种子近中心曲线,并按射程顺序向外生长一个平坦,高度一致的表面;只有位于这一表面的点才被认为是地面. 这些地面点为道路支线,道路支线将每个曲线从车辆中心线向外延伸至第一个边界线,将种子横跨曲线传播,并用加强空间一致性的凝聚通道关闭. 其结果为完整的点云,非地面(障碍),地面,和道路的每个点标有3个. 这些都是可供下游自动驾驶模块消耗的,如占用网图、障碍探测或导航。 下文对方法的每个阶段作了深入的说明。

blocks.en: The complete method has been implemented in C++ and wrapped as ROS 2 (Humble) nodes. Therefore, the pipeline can be integrated directly into a real autonomous-driving stack: it subscribes to the point cloud streamed by the LiDAR’s driver and publishes each label on its own standard PointCloud2 topic, ready for the downstream modules to consume. In this form the method runs online, at the sensor’s full frame rate, and on an on-board CPU alone.
blocks.zh: 完整的方法已经在C++中实施,并被包裹为ROS 2 (Humble)节点. 因此,管道可以直接集成到一个真正的自主驾驶堆:它订阅LiDAR驱动程序流出的点云,并在自己的标准点Cloud2主题上发布每个标签,准备下游模块消耗. 这种方法以这种方式在线运行,以传感器的全帧速率运行,并单独在船上的CPU上运行.

blocks.en: III-B Curve-Cell Ground Segmentation
blocks.zh: III-B 曲线-环线地面分割

blocks.en: Ground segmentation opens the proposed segmentation pipeline (Fig. 4 ): it produces the coarse ground surface on which the fine road stage is later run. Its design exploits the intrinsic characteristics of hybrid solid-state data. Because the sensor concentrates a very high density into a front-facing FOV, each small patch of ground carries many measurements, so a per-patch median height and spread are stable and well-supported statistics, and the tightly spaced curves (unlike spaced rings) make neighboring patches genuinely adjacent. This density is what lets the method work by pure local geometry, and it shapes two design choices at the core of the method. First, it is fully relative: it fits no global or per-zone plane and imposes no absolute height threshold, deciding ground purely from local neighbors, so it respects the road’s camber, its slopes and ramps, and the roll the sensor picks up in turns. Second, it reasons vertically as well as along the surface. Because the dense, front-facing cloud places many points on every object’s profile per frame, the method can recognize an obstacle’s flat base from the column of returns standing directly above it and keep it out of the ground. These design choices, when combined, give the method its robustness and precision, respectively.
blocks.zh: 地面分解开启了拟议的分解管道(图4):它产生粗糙的地面表面,而细小的路面在其中运行. 它的设计利用混合固态数据的内在特征. 由于感应器将非常高的密度集中到一个前立面的FOV中,因此每个小块的地面上都承载着许多测量,所以每平方尺的中位高度和分布是稳定的,得到良好支持的统计数据,而紧凑的间距曲线(不像空格环)使得相邻的补丁真正相邻. 这种密度使得方法通过纯粹的局部几何来工作,它塑造了方法核心的两个设计选择. 首先,它是完全相对的:它没有适合全球或区间平面,也没有强制规定绝对高度阈值,完全从当地邻居那里决定地面,因此它尊重道路的凸轮、斜坡和坡道,而感应器的滚滚则依次拾起。 第二,它从垂直角度以及沿着表面来解释。 因为密密的前置云在每帧物体的剖面上都放置了许多点,所以这个方法可以识别一个障碍的平面基底,从正上方的返回柱上立起,使其远离地面. 这些设计选择合并后,使方法分别具有稳健性和精确性.

Each individual scan curve, already indexed by the sensor driver, is split into small cells of roughly fixed point count, whose width is allowed to grow with range to adapt to distant, sparser curves. Each cell c c of n n points is summarized by three descriptors it carries: its planar centroid ( x , y ) c (x,y)_{c} , its median height z ¯ c \bar{z}_{c} , and a trimmed vertical spread σ c \sigma_{c} , z ¯ c = median ⁡ { z 𝐩 : 𝐩 ∈ c } , σ c = z ( n − 2 ) − z ( 3 ) , \bar{z}_{c}=\operatorname{median}\{z_{\mathbf{p}}:\mathbf{p}\in c\},\qquad\sigma_{c}=z_{(n-2)}-z_{(3)}, (2) where z ( 1 ) ≤ ⋯ ≤ z ( n ) z_{(1)}\leq\dots\leq z_{(n)} are the cell’s sorted point heights, so the trimmed height spread σ c \sigma_{c} drops the two highest and two lowest returns. The curves are ranked from near to far, and the neighbors of a cell are its lateral neighbors on the same curve together with the cells of the rank-adjacent curves within a radial reach that widens with range, as the curves spread apart. The surface is then grown from seeds: the frontal cells immediately ahead of the vehicle centerline are marked ground \raisebox{-0.7pt}{\scriptsize1}⃝ , since this area is always ground. The key lies on the one dimension the growth ignores, the vertical axis: true ground has open space above it, whereas an object base sits beneath a rising column of cells. Before seeding, our method therefore tests each cell c c against those above it. blocks.en: III-C Per-Curve Road Segmentation
blocks.zh: III-C 环城公路分区

blocks.en: The proposed ground segmentation method is too coarse to segment the road: cell-based approaches cannot distinguish the ego road from the flush or raised surfaces around it (sidewalks, parking strips, adjacent roads), which are just as flat and continuous. Telling them apart means resolving the centimetric curb (at worst) that bounds the road without mistaking a slope or a cambered road for one. This is difficult on sparse data, which is why widely used geometric ground filters such as Patchwork++ [ 17 ] and Autoware’s ray-ground filter [ 15 ] stop at ground segmentation, and why the few geometric methods that reach the road at all are close-range and rely on the ring structure of a spinning sensor (Section II ).
blocks.zh: 拟议的地面分割方法过于粗糙,无法分割道路:基于细胞的方法无法区分自负道路与周围的冲水或抬高的表面(侧行道,停车带,相邻道路),这些道路同样平坦且连续. 把他们分开说意味着解决(最糟糕的)封闭道路的摄氏度问题,而不误走一条斜坡或凸轮道路。 这在零星的数据上是困难的,这就是为什么广泛使用的几何地面滤波器,如Patchwork++[17]和Autoware的射线地面滤波器[15]停止在地面的分割,为什么到达道路的几何方法完全是近距离的,依赖于旋转传感器的环状结构(第二节).

blocks.en: A hybrid solid-state point cloud lifts both limitations. Its density resolves a curb as a clear step in height even at range, and its concave, non-ring curves add a second, purely geometric and robust signature. A road edge therefore announces itself twice over in an HSS point cloud: a step in height as the curb (or fence, guardrail, or wall) rises, and a fold-back in range as the curve bends inward where the boundary cuts it, creating a visible seam between the road and the rest of the point cloud, as shown in Fig. 2b . Both cues are local and relative, so they survive camber, bank, grade, and the roll the sensor experiences in turns.
blocks.zh: 混合固态点云可以解除两种限制. 其密度解决了弯曲,是即使是在射程范围内的高度的一个明确步骤,其凸起的非环曲线增加了第二个纯粹几何和坚固的特征. 因此,一个道路边缘在HSS点云中两次宣布自己:随着路边(或栅栏,护栏,或墙壁)升起,高度上升了一步,曲线向内弯曲,边界被切断,在路面和点云其余部分之间形成明显的缝隙,如图所示。 第2款b项 这两个提示都是本地的和相对的,所以它们在凸轮,银行,品级, 和旋转的传感器体验。

blocks.en: Additionally, three guard mechanisms strengthen the walk where it is most vulnerable to errors (road segments without a curb, flush sidewalks, banked turns, strong body roll, and stray early returns).
blocks.zh: 此外,有3个警卫机制加强最容易出错的行走(路段没有路口、冲刷人行道、银行转弯、强力车身卷,以及失路的提前返回)。

blocks.en: Step-cut \raisebox{-0.7pt}{\scriptsize4}⃝ removes lateral bleed. If the walk slips past a missing or buried curb, it continues onto the sidewalk and may wrongly seed the next curve there, creating a cascading false-positive error. Each curve’s segmented road is therefore checked outward against the slope of the inner road extrapolated across the gap: a genuinely banked road continues that slope and is kept, whereas a sidewalk sits a step above it and is cut, along with everything beyond.
blocks.zh: 步骤剪切\causebox{-0.7pt 校对:Soup 如果行走滑过一个缺失或埋没的路边,它会继续走在人行道上,并可能错误地播下一条曲线,从而造成连串的假阳性错误. 因此,每条曲线的支路都与横跨缺口的内路斜坡相对照:一条真正有屏蔽的公路继续了这一斜坡并保留下来,而一条人行道则坐落在斜坡的上方并被切除。

blocks.en: Internal heal \raisebox{-0.7pt}{\scriptsize5}⃝ removes false-negative holes. Interior gaps that are flanked by road on both sides, short, smooth, and at road height are filled in, closing the phantom non-road specks (caused by stray early returns) that a downstream module could mistake for an obstacle ahead.

As a final step the cloud is leveled for this pass alone using a robust plane fit on the near road, which cancels the roll the vehicle induces while turning. A road-height reference surface is then grown outward from the trusted near road, stopped wherever it turns rough or steps up so that it never climbs a sidewalk; any road point standing more than a small margin above that reference is demoted as raised bleed, and only when its neighbors are demoted too, so no isolated holes are opened.

blocks.en: The proposed road segmentation method is thus purely geometric and single-shot, and because it reasons one curve at a time, essentially in one dimension, it runs in real time on a single CPU core. It returns the ego road, the road the vehicle is driving on, cleanly separated from the flat non-drivable ground around it, and holds up on the hardest scenarios (roundabouts and sharp turns included), as shown in Section V-C .
blocks.zh: 因此,拟议的路段划分方法纯粹是几何式和单射法,由于它使得一次有一个曲线,基本上在一个维度上,它实时运行在一个单独的CPU核心上. 如第五至C节所示,它返回了自负之路、车辆所开的道路、与周围平坦的不可驾驶地面清洁分离,并坚挺了最困难的情景(四周和包括尖锐转弯)。

blocks.en: IV Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 四 实验设置

blocks.en: As Section II established, the few hybrid or solid-state-centric datasets that exist target object detection or non-automotive scenes, and none is a benchmark dedicated to per-point ground and road segmentation for an automotive hybrid solid-state sensor in real-world driving scenarios. Therefore, developing and evaluating the proposed method has required recording and labeling our own data. This section describes the platforms and sensor that have made this work possible, the resulting publicly released HySoLiD-Drive benchmark, and the experimental protocol followed to keep the evaluation and comparison fair.
blocks.zh: 第二节确定,少数存在目标物体探测或非自动场景的混合或固态-以固态为中心的数据集,没有一个数据集是用于在现实世界驱动情景中汽车混合固态传感器每点地面和道路分割的基准. 因此,制定和评价拟议方法需要记录和标注我们自己的数据。 本节介绍使得这项工作得以实现的平台和传感器,由此而公开发布的HySoLiD-Drive基准,以及为了保持评价和比较的公平而遵循的实验协议.

blocks.en: IV-A Platforms and Sensor
blocks.zh: 平台和传感器

blocks.en: The method has been developed and evaluated on real driving data from two research autonomous vehicles at Universidad Carlos III de Madrid: ATLAS, a retrofitted first-generation electric Mitsubishi i-MiEV [ 40 ] , and Kalipso, a modified Hyundai Ioniq plug-in hybrid. Two vehicles have been used instead of one because their different geometry forces the sensor to sit at a different height and pitch, verifying that the geometric method generalizes rather than being tuned to a single vehicle and mount.
blocks.zh: 该方法是从马德里卡洛斯三世大学的两台研究自主车辆中开发并评价的真实驾驶数据:ATLAS,一台经过改造的第一代电动三菱i-MiEV[40],和Kalipso,一台经过改造的现代Ioniq插座混合动力. 使用两辆而不是一辆是因为它们不同的几何图案迫使传感器坐落在不同的高度和投球上,证实几何方法一般化,而不是被调制成单辆汽车和挂载.

blocks.en: Both carry the same Innovusion (now Seyond) Falcon Kinetic, a long-range hybrid solid-state LiDAR [ 10 ] . It steers a single 1550 nm fiber laser with a rotating polygon mirror and an oscillating galvanometer, covering a 120 ∘ × 25 ∘ 120^{\circ}\times 25^{\circ} field of view with an angular resolution of 0.18 ∘ × 0.24 ∘ 0.18^{\circ}\times 0.24^{\circ} that densifies to 0.09 ∘ × 0.08 ∘ 0.09^{\circ}\times 0.08^{\circ} inside the sensor’s region of interest. It produces 1500 scan lines per second with a range accuracy of ± 2 \pm 2 cm and a maximum range of 250 m at 10% reflectivity; a typical frame contains approximately 88 000 points.
blocks.zh: 两者都搭载了相同的创新(现在的Seyond)猎鹰Kinetic,一种远程混合固态LiDAR [10]. 它用旋转的多边形镜和振荡伽微仪,驱动单张1550纳米纤维激光,覆盖120 × × 25 × 120 × × 120 × × 120 × × 25 × × × rcrc}视场,角分辨率为0.18 × × 0.24 × 0.18 × × × × × 0.18 × × × × × × 光圈 0点零9分 = 0.08分 = 0.09分 08.circ] 在感应器感兴趣的区域。 它每秒产生1500条扫描线,范围精度为±2\pm2cm,最大范围为250m,反射率为10%;一个典型的框架包含约88000点.

blocks.en: On both vehicles the sensor is mounted front-facing at the top of the windshield. This is the standard position for this sensor class, also adopted in production integrations such as the Xiaomi SU7, because the vehicle’s own hood absorbs part of the roughly 2 m near-field blind zone inherent to the sensor.
blocks.zh: 在这两辆车上,传感器安装在挡风玻璃顶部的前方。 这是这种传感器类的标准位置,在Xiaomi SU7等生产集成中也采用,因为车辆本身的车盖吸收了传感器固有的大约2米近野盲区的一部分.

blocks.en: The single-sensor scope is deliberate: a production vehicle carries only one HSS LiDAR, and HySoLiD-Drive is built for exactly that setting. GHySSeg, moreover, exploits only the two properties every hybrid solid-state sensor shares, a dense front-facing field of view and a non-ring, per-curve scan pattern (Section III-A ), so it is not Seyond- or Falcon-exclusive. Furthermore, the two-vehicle split already probes the method’s generality along a key axis of variation for a geometric method, the sensor pose (Section IV-C ). Extending the same transfer to other sensors is left to future work.
blocks.zh: 单传感器范围是精心设计的:生产车辆只搭载一台HSS LiDAR,而HySoLiD-Drive是专门为这个设置而建造的。 此外,GHySSeg只利用混合固态传感器共享的两种特性,一个密集的前视场和一个非环的每曲线扫描模式(第III-A节),因此它并非Seyond-或Falcon-独占性. 此外,两辆车辆的拆分已经探测了该方法在几何法变异的关键轴上的通用性,即传感器的形状(第四节-C节)。 将同样的转让扩展到其他传感器则留给未来工作。

blocks.en: Point clouds are produced at the sensor’s native 10 Hz and decoded in real time by the manufacturer’s ROS 2 driver from Ethernet packets into PointCloud2 messages. A static calibration stage compensates for the constant mounting pitch and roll. The compensated point cloud is the only input to the proposed method (see Fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 点云由传感器的原生10赫兹制成,由制造商的ROS 2驱动程序从Ethernet包中实时解码为PointCloud2消息. 一个静态的校准阶段可以补偿不断上升的投球和滚球. 补偿点云是对拟议方法的唯一投入(见图4)。

blocks.en: All experiments, for all methods, ours and the state-of-the-art baselines’, have been run on a single portable computer with an AMD Ryzen 7 7435HS CPU, 24 GB DDR5 4800 MT/s RAM, and an RTX 4060 8 GB GPU, so that reported runtimes and performance are directly comparable.
blocks.zh: 所有实验,包括我们的方法和最新基线,都用一台便携式计算机运行,其中AMD Ryzen 7 7435HS CPU, 24 GB DDR5 4800 MT/s RAM, 以及 RTX 4060 8 GB GPU, 所报道的运行时间和性能可以直接比较。

blocks.en: IV-B The HySoLiD-Drive Benchmark
blocks.zh: 四-B 氢氟烷烃驱动基准

blocks.en: Complete driving routes have been recorded with both vehicles in Leganés, Madrid, under normal traffic, with a human driver covering the full range of everyday driving scenarios: urban streets, motorways, roundabouts, sharp turns, forks, ramps, elevated roads, crosswalks, parking entries and exits, and roads of one to four lanes. These drives have yielded more than 7000 sequential raw frames, which have been the basis for developing the method but carry no ground truth.
blocks.zh: 在正常交通条件下,马德里勒加内斯的两辆车都记录了完整的行驶路线,一名人力司机负责全程的日常行驶情况:城市街道、机动车道、环路、锐转弯、叉子、坡道、高架道路、横行道、停车出入口以及一至四车道的道路。 这些驱动器已经产生了超过7000个连续的原始帧,它们一直是开发方法的基础,但却没有带地面真理.

blocks.en: From them, 100 frames have been handpicked for scenario diversity, evenly split between the two vehicles (50 ATLAS, 50 Kalipso), and labeled manually point by point into four nested classes: non-ground, ground, road, and ego-road. The nesting allows a single annotation to serve both tasks: every ego-road point is a road point and every road point is a ground point. Ground segmentation is evaluated against the ground class, and road segmentation against the ego-road class, which is what the method’s road output denotes. The even split allows accuracy to be reported per vehicle throughout.
blocks.zh: 从它们中,100帧被选取来进行情景多样性,在两辆车辆(50辆ATLAS,50辆Kalipso)之间均匀分割,并用手动点标注成四个筑巢类:非地面,地面,道路,和自负路. 筑巢允许单条注释为两种任务服务:每个自负-路点都是路点,每个路点都是地面点. 地面分界是对照地面等级来评价的,公路分界是对照自负道路等级来评价的,而道路分界是该方法道路产出的意思。 平分后,每辆车辆全程都能报告准确性。

blocks.en: The dataset was originally intended only for the experiments and results of the presented work, but as labeled hybrid solid-state data is scarce and per-point 3-D annotation is very costly we have decided to release it instead as HySoLiD-Drive: to our knowledge the first public benchmark targeting ground and road segmentation on an automotive hybrid solid-state LiDAR. The benchmark data, both the labeled frames and the unlabeled complete sequences, is archived on Zenodo under a permanent DOI [ 11 ] . The accompanying public repository [ 41 ] provides the data-loading and evaluation tools, the documentation, the submission rules, and a leaderboard seeded with the results of this work and open to community submission.
blocks.zh: 数据集最初只用于实验和所介绍的工作成果,但由于标注的混合固态数据稀缺,每点3-D注释成本很高,我们决定发布它作为HySoLiD-Drive:据我们所知,第一个公共基准针对汽车混合固态LiDAR上的地面和道路分割. 基准数据,无论是标注的帧还是未标注的完整序列,都以永久的DOI [11] 下存档于Zenodo. 配套的公共寄存器[41]提供数据加载和评价工具,文件,提交规则,以及带有这项工作成果并开放给社区提交的领导板.

blocks.en: Beyond the results reported in Section V , the benchmark is intended as a resource for the community. The labeled split supports quantitative evaluation of any ground or road segmentation method, geometric or learned, on hybrid solid-state data under real driving conditions. Moreover, the two unlabeled complete sequences (3500 frames per vehicle) support self-supervised learning, domain adaptation from mechanical to hybrid solid-state data, runtime profiling under continuous driving, temporal and multi-frame approaches, and the development of new geometric methods. Across both splits, the even division between two vehicles with different mounting geometries makes generalization across sensor pose measurable. It is modest in size next to SemanticKITTI, but its scenario diversity and, above all, its sensor make it a starting point for work that established mechanical-oriented datasets cannot support: the automotive industry is moving toward solid-state sensing, yet every major public benchmark remains focused on mechanical LiDAR, so methods for the sensors now entering production cannot be developed or validated on public data. HySoLiD-Drive is a first step toward closing that gap.
blocks.zh: 除了第五节报告的结果外,该基准还打算作为社区的资源。 贴标签的拆分支持在实际驱动条件下对混合固体状态数据进行几何或学到的任何地面或道路分割方法的定量评价。 此外,两个无标签的完整序列(每辆车3500帧)支持自我监督的学习,域位由机械数据改为混合固态数据,连续驱动下的运行时间剖面,时间和多帧方法,以及开发新的几何方法. 在两种分布方式中,两辆车之间均匀的划分,不同的升降几何仪使传感器的通用化具有可测量性。 它与SemanticKITTI相邻的体积不大,但是它的场景多样性,最重要的是它的传感器使它成为建立面向机械的数据集无法支持的工作的起点:汽车工业正向固态感知发展,然而每个主要的公用基准仍然以机械LiDAR为主,因此现在进入生产的传感器的方法无法在公共数据上开发或验证. HySoLiD -Drive是缩小这一差距的第一步。

blocks.en: IV-C Baselines and Protocol
blocks.zh: 四-C 基线和议定书

blocks.en: The proposed method has been compared against six modern 3-D LiDAR segmentation methods, three per task, all of them reviewed in Section II . They have been selected to represent the current state of the art and to span both schools of thought identified there (Table II ).
blocks.zh: 将拟议的方法与六种现代的三维LiDAR分解方法作了比较,每种任务3种,第二节审查了所有这些方法。 它们被选中来代表目前的艺术状况,并贯穿其中所确定的两个思想流派(表二)。

blocks.en: The selection is deliberately asymmetric, reflecting where each school is strongest. Geometric methods dominate ground estimation, where the physical flatness of the surface is a reliable cue, so two of the three ground baselines are geometric (Patchwork++ and CSF) and one learned (GndNet). Learned methods dominate strict road segmentation, where the boundary is more semantic than geometric, so two of the three road baselines are learned (WaffleIron and PTv3). The one geometric road baseline is Patchwork++ reused: since no publicly available geometric road segmenter is free of a spinning LiDAR’s ring structure (Section II ), we have tuned the dominant geometric ground filter so strictly on the labeled frames that only the smooth ego-road surface survives and its ground output then serves as a road estimate.
blocks.zh: 选择是故意不对称的,反映了每个学校最强的地方. 几何方法在地面估计中占主导地位,地面的物理平坦度是一个可靠的提示,因此三个地面基线中有两个是几何(Patchwork++和CSF),一个是学到的(GndNet). 学到的方法在严格的路段划分中占据主导地位,边界比几何更为语义化,因此三条路基线中有两条(WaffleIron和PTv3)被学习. 一个几何道路基线是Patchwork++再利用:由于没有公开的几何路段没有旋转的LiDAR的环状结构(第二节),我们把主要的几何地面过滤器严格地调整在贴着标签的构架上,只有平滑的自负路面才能幸存下来,其地面输出就成了道路的估计。

blocks.en: All six are designed for or trained on spinning mechanical LiDAR data, since public benchmarks provide only such data and mechanical scanning remains the established technology. The learned baselines have therefore been evaluated without retraining: no public labeled hybrid solid-state dataset for ground and road segmentation of sufficient size exists for training. The geometric baselines, by contrast, have been tuned using their available parameters and are reported at their best configuration on our data.
blocks.zh: 所有6个都为旋转机械LiDAR数据设计或培训,因为公共基准只提供这类数据,机械扫描仍然是既定技术。 因此,在没有再培训的情况下评估了学到的基线:没有关于足够规模的地面和道路分区的公共标有混合固体状态数据集可供培训使用。 相比之下,几何基线是利用现有参数调整的,并在我们的数据中以最佳的配置报告。

blocks.en: The proposed method has been developed and tuned on Kalipso alone. To avoid rewarding that tuning, its parameters have been frozen and applied unchanged to ATLAS; ATLAS therefore acts as a held-out vehicle to test generalization and avoid overfitting. Our method is thus evaluated under a stricter protocol than the baselines, which are tuned on the full set.
blocks.zh: 拟议的方法已经制定,并仅以卡利普索为主。 为了避免奖励这种调谐,其参数被冻结,并保持不变地适用于ATLAS;因此,ATLAS充当了一种被搁置的载体,以测试通俗化,避免过于适应. 因此,根据比基线更严格的协议评估我们的方法,基线是根据整套标准调整的。

Accuracy is reported with the metrics standard in the segmentation literature: intersection over union (IoU) as the primary score, together with precision ( P P ), recall ( R R ), and F1 score, which localize the source of each error, P = TP TP + FP , R = TP TP + FN , \displaystyle P=\frac{\mathrm{TP}}{\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FP}},\quad R=\frac{\mathrm{TP}}{\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FN}}, (11) F1 = 2 ​ TP 2 ​ TP + FP + FN , IoU = TP TP + FP + FN , \displaystyle\mathrm{F1}=\frac{2\,\mathrm{TP}}{2\,\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FP}+\mathrm{FN}},\quad\mathrm{IoU}=\frac{\mathrm{TP}}{\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FP}+\mathrm{FN}}, where TP \mathrm{TP} , FP \mathrm{FP} , and FN \mathrm{FN} count the true positive, false positive, and false negative points for the evaluated class (ground or ego-road); all metrics are broken down per vehicle. Real-time performance is measured on the 3500 continuous unlabeled frames of each vehicle, timing computation only (disk and message I/O excluded), after discarding 10 warm-up frames, with the same frame count for every method.

blocks.en: V Results
blocks.zh: 五 结果

blocks.en: The proposed method has been thoroughly evaluated through four experiments, each addressing a different property: its segmentation accuracy against the state of the art (Section V-A ), its real-time performance under real-world driving conditions (Section V-B ), the contribution of each ideated mechanism, isolated in an ablation study (Section V-C ), and its behavior and limitations in the hardest scenes, examined qualitatively (Section V-D ). Every experiment has been run on HySoLiD-Drive, so all results are reproducible on the public benchmark.
blocks.zh: 通过四项实验,对拟议方法进行了彻底评价,每项实验涉及不同的属性:其分解精确度与最新技术(第五节-A节),在现实世界驾驶条件下的实时性能(第五节-B节),在一项消化研究(第五节-C节)中孤立的每一种设想机制的贡献及其在最困难场景中的行为和局限,从质量上加以审查(第五节-D节)。 每一个实验都在HySoLiD-Drive上运行,因此所有结果都可以在公共基准上复制.

blocks.en: V-A Segmentation Accuracy
blocks.zh: V- A 分区精确度

blocks.en: Table II is the product of running the proposed ground and road segmentation pipeline and the state-of-the-art methods on the 100 distinct, labeled frames from HySoLiD-Drive. Results are split by vehicle (Kalipso, on which the method has been tuned, and ATLAS, on which it runs unchanged) and over the full set. For each metric, the best result is shown in bold and the second best underlined.
blocks.zh: 表二是从HySoLiD-Drive公司运行拟议的地面和道路分割管道以及100个不同、贴有标签的框架的先进方法的产品。 结果按车辆(卡利普索,方法已调整,ATLAS,其运行情况未变)和整个组合来划分。 对于每个衡量标准,最佳结果以黑体表示,第二佳下划线显示。

blocks.en: TABLE II: Ground and Road Segmentation Accuracy on HySoLiD-Drive Benchmark.
blocks.zh: 表格 二:HySoLiD-Drive基准上的地面和道路分割精确度。

blocks.en: On the ground task, Table II shows that GHySSeg achieves the highest IoU (0.896) and F1 score (0.944), ahead of Patchwork++ (0.877 IoU) and CSF (0.850 IoU); GndNet, the only learned ground baseline, ranks considerably lower at 0.736. This ranking was expected: GHySSeg is designed to exploit hybrid solid-state geometry, whereas the baselines rely on generic representations or are tailored to mechanical LiDAR. Patchwork++ nonetheless remains surprisingly competitive despite its ring-based formulation, which illustrates its adaptability and explains its wide adoption for ground segmentation tasks. The decisive difference, however, is precision. Our ground method is deliberately built to maximize it, because a false ground point (a real obstacle labeled as traversable) is the safety-critical error in autonomous driving that could cause a fatal collision [ 42 ] . GHySSeg reaches 0.961 precision against 0.924 for Patchwork++, and is the only method that pairs high precision with high recall (0.931). CSF and GndNet achieve higher recall (0.989 and 0.985, even up to 0.999 for CSF on Kalipso), but at the cost of numerous false positives (most severely GndNet), which could let real, collidable obstacles pass as ground in a real application. These results support our thesis: on hybrid solid-state data, a native geometric method surpasses the established state of the art even where geometric methods are traditionally strongest (ground segmentation). The margin is narrower than expected, however, because mature methods such as Patchwork++ and CSF withstand the domain gap far better than learned ones, as demonstrated. Across vehicles, freezing the parameters for ATLAS costs only 0.029 IoU and 0.017 F1 score relative to Kalipso, indicating that mounting geometry and tuning have a real but minor effect on the proposed ground segmentation method.
blocks.zh: 在地面任务上,表二显示GHySSeg取得了最高的IoU(0.896)和F1得分(0.944),领先于Patchwork++(0.877 IoU)和CSF(0.850 IoU);GndNet是唯一的学习到的地面基线,在0.736位位位列下. 这一排名是预期的:GHySSeg旨在利用混合固态几何,而基线则依赖于通用的表示或适合机械的LiDAR. 尽管如此,补丁++仍然具有令人惊讶的竞争力,尽管其以环为基础的配方说明了其适应性,并解释了其广泛采用地面分割任务的原因。 然而,决定性的区别在于准确性。 我们的地面方法被刻意建造来达到最大化,因为一个虚假的地面点(一个被标记为可移动性的真正障碍)是自主驾驶中的安全关键错误,这可能造成致命碰撞[42]. GHySSeg在Patchwork++的0.961精度达到0.924精度,是将高精度与高召回(0.931. CSF和GndNet实现了更高的召回率(卡利普索上的CSF甚至高达0.999),但代价是大量假阳性(最严重的是GndNet),这些假阳性可以让真实的,可碰撞的障碍随着实际应用的落地而通过. 这些结果支持了我们的论文:在混合固态数据上,即使几何方法传统上最强(地面分裂),本土几何方法也超过了既定的艺术状态. 然而,比预期的差值更窄,因为Patchwork++和CSF等成熟方法比所学的更能承受域间隙,这一点已经证明. 在整个车辆中,与卡利普索相比,ATLAS的参数只冻结了0.029 IoU和0.017 F1的得分,这表明不断上升的几何学和调值对拟议的地面分割方法具有实际但微弱的影响。

blocks.en: On the road task, GHySSeg dominates every metric on both vehicles, and by a wide margin: its 0.907 IoU over the full set exceeds the runner-up, WaffleIron (0.785), by more than 0.12, while road-tuned Patchwork++ reaches only 0.727 and PTv3 collapses to 0.283. With these results we are able to identify two causes that explain this gap. First, classical purely geometric methods, even the best and most modern, struggle to refine ground into road even on dense clouds: road-tuned Patchwork++ attains the second-highest recall (0.895) but bleeds into sidewalks and non-road ground, which lowers its precision and caps its IoU. Second, the learned baselines suffer heavily from the domain gap; trained on mechanical-LiDAR datasets (KITTI, nuScenes) and applied without retraining, they face an unfamiliar topology. The effect is most pronounced for the heavy transformer approach PTv3, which stays at 0.283 IoU. WaffleIron generalizes better, holding up surprisingly well on the unfamiliar data, but still lags in recall (0.856). These results support the central claim of this article: by exploiting hybrid solid-state data characteristics, geometric road segmentation is not only feasible but comfortably outperforms non-retrained learned models and state-of-the-art non-specialized geometric methods, reaching 0.969 precision from a purely geometric formulation. The cross-vehicle comparison is equally telling: unlike on the ground task, GHySSeg scores higher on ATLAS (0.921 IoU) than on Kalipso (0.892), so no cross-vehicle penalty or re-tuning is incurred. This outcome is partly due to easier road scenes on ATLAS; even so, it is achieved with parameters tuned solely on Kalipso.
blocks.zh: 在公路任务上,GHySSeg在两辆汽车上都占据了每个公制的主导地位,而且有很大的优势:它的0.907IoU在整组车辆上超过了跑步器WaffleIron(0.785),超过0.12,而路调的Patchwork++只达到0.727,PTv3坍塌到0.283. 有了这些结果,我们就能够找出造成这一差距的两个原因。 首先,古典纯粹的几何方法,甚至最先进和最现代的方法,努力将地面精炼成道路,甚至在密集的云层上也是如此:路调的补丁工作++实现了第二高的召回(0.895),但血流成人行道和非道路地面,降低了其精度,封顶了它的IoU。 其次,所学的基线因域间差距而严重受损;在机械-LiDAR数据集(KITTI,nuScenes)方面受过培训,在不经过再培训的情况下,它们面临着一种不熟悉的地形。 对PTv3重变压器方法的影响最为明显,它停留在0.283IoU。 WaffleIron的概括性更好,令人惊讶的是,对不熟悉的数据保持良好,但在召回方面仍然滞后(0.856)。 这些结果支持了本条的中心主张:通过利用杂交固态数据特性,几何路段不仅可行,而且舒适地超过了非再训练的学习模型和最先进的非专用几何方法,从纯几何配方达到0.969的精度. 交叉车辆比较同样说明问题:与地面任务不同,GHySSeg在ATLAS(0.921 IoU)上的得分高于卡利普索(0.892)的得分,因此没有发生交叉车辆处罚或重新调整. 这一结果部分是由于在ATLAS上的道路场景比较容易;即使如此,它也是通过仅以卡利普索为主的参数来实现的.

blocks.en: V-B Runtime
blocks.zh: V-B 运行时间

blocks.en: The second most relevant results concern real-time performance. Real-time operation is a critical requirement for autonomous driving: an on-board perception method must deliver its output in time for the downstream navigation, decision, and control modules to act on it [ 43 ] . Our pipeline and the baseline methods have therefore been profiled on the two continuous real-world drives of HySoLiD-Drive (Section IV-C ) to measure and compare their processing time against a 100 ms budget (the sensor’s native 10 Hz frame period), since exceeding it causes the method to drop frames or lag. Figure 7 shows the per-frame processing time of each method, split by vehicle, on a logarithmic scale.
blocks.zh: 第二大相关成果涉及实时业绩。 实时操作是自主驱动的关键要求:机载感知方法必须及时交付其输出,以便下游导航,决策,控制模块能够对此采取行动[43]. 因此,我们的管道和基线方法被描述在HySoLiD-Drive(第四-C节)的两个连续的实时驱动器上,以衡量和比较其处理时间与100毫秒的预算(传感器的原生10赫兹帧期),因为超过这一时间会导致下降帧或滞后的方法。 图7显示每种方法的每帧处理时间,按车辆分列,按对数尺度排列。

blocks.en: The first thing that we can observe in Fig. 7 is that the complete GHySSeg pipeline (ground followed by road) runs in about 22 ms per frame on both vehicles, which is comfortably within the 100 ms budget; even the single worst frame (48.1 ms on Kalipso) stays below half the frame period, leaving more than 50 ms of headroom for downstream planning and control. Ground and road contribute similarly under nominal conditions ( ∼ \sim 10 and ∼ \sim 12 ms), but road is the more variable stage: its guard mechanisms activate only when needed, so a frame requiring bald-spot repair or strong roll compensation costs more than a clean straight one, whereas ground stays stable across all 7000 frames. The per-frame standard deviation remains small in both cases ( ∼ \sim 2 and ∼ \sim 4 ms), so latency is predictable, a property paramount for driving safety. These results demonstrate that the proposed pipeline, even with both methods stacked, achieves real-time performance running on a single CPU core.
blocks.zh: 在菲格可以观察到的第一件事 7是完整的GHySSeg输油管(地面后是公路)在两辆车上每帧运行约22ms,这在100ms的预算范围内是舒适的;即使是最差的单帧(卡利普索的48.1ms)也停留在半帧期以下,留下了超过50ms的车头用于下游规划和控制. 地面和道路在名义条件下也有同样的贡献(\\sim 10和\sim 12 mss),但道路是比较可变的阶段:它的护卫机制只在需要时才启动,因此,一个需要光头点修复或强卷补偿的构架比干净的直面成本还要高,而地面在所有7000帧之间保持稳定。 在这两种情况下,每帧标准差仍然很小(\\sim 2 和\sim 4 ms),因此耐久性是可以预测的,这是对驾驶安全至关重要的财产。 这些结果表明,拟议的管道,即使采用两种方法堆叠,也能在单个CPU核心上实现实时性能运行.

blocks.en: Regarding the baselines’ performance when processing hybrid solid-state data, Patchwork++ is the fastest method, marginally quicker than both GHySSeg stages at ∼ \sim 10 ms per frame for both tasks and vehicles with very low variance, confirming that its authors’ real-time claims hold up well even on non-mechanical data. GndNet is the only other method within budget, matching Patchwork++ at ∼ \sim 10 ms per frame with the lowest spread of all methods; it requires a GPU to run, however, adding cost and power consumption to the vehicle. The remaining methods exceed the 100 ms budget. CSF is the most inconsistent with a median per-frame time of 2.25 s on ATLAS and 1.67 s on Kalipso, and taking up to 282 s to process a single frame; this is expected of an offline mapping and topography tool rather than a real-time segmenter. WaffleIron ( ∼ \sim 175 ms per-frame median) and PTv3, the slowest method at ∼ \sim 3.5 s, both remain too heavy (despite the GPU processing) for real-time inference on a consumer-grade RTX 4060 due to their larger models and the many classes they segment beyond road.
blocks.zh: 关于处理混合固态数据时的基准性能,Patchwork++是最快的方法,略快于任务和差异很小的车辆的GHySSeg阶段(每帧为 \sim 10 ms),证实其作者的实时索赔即使在非机械数据上都得到了很好的支持。 风 Net是预算内唯一的其他方法,将Patchwork++在每帧\sim 10 ms中匹配到所有方法的最小分布;然而它需要GPU运行,为车辆增加成本和功耗. 其余方法超过了100ms的预算。 CSF最不符合每帧时间的中位数,在ATLAS上为2.25秒,在卡利普索上为1.67秒,处理单个帧最多可达282秒;这预计是一个离线绘图和地形工具,而不是实时分区器. WaffleIron (\\sim 175ms每帧中位数)和PTv3,是\\sim 3.5s最慢的方法,两者都仍然太重(尽管GPU处理),无法实时推断一个消费级的RTX 4060,原因是它们的型号较大,而且它们隔路分许多类.

blocks.en: Across vehicles, every method (not only the proposed one) shows a wider spread on Kalipso, whose more demanding route includes stretches where the sensor sees up to 200 m ahead, and traversing curves at that range costs additional time; the mean, however, stays consistent between vehicles for GHySSeg, confirming stable performance across environments and vehicles.
blocks.zh: 在各种车辆中,每一种方法(不仅仅是拟议方法)在卡利普索的传播范围都更广,其更严格的路线包括传感器在前方200米处视线伸展,并在这一距离内绕过曲线,这需要花费更多的时间;然而,在GHySSeg车辆之间,其平均值保持不变,证实了环境和车辆之间的稳定性能。

blocks.en: V-C Ablation Study
blocks.zh: V-C 读取研究

blocks.en: As described in Section III , both proposed methods share the per-curve seeding principle but pursue different goals (coarse ground versus fine road) by cumulatively stacking mechanisms, each targeting a specific failure observed in real data. Consistent with the safety priorities of autonomous driving, every mechanism is meant to raise the floor (the worst-case scenario) and favor precision, so that behavior stays predictable across scenes and catastrophic failures are avoided [ 42 ] . To make each stage’s purpose explicit, we have performed a cumulative ablation on the 100 labeled frames of HySoLiD-Drive, grouped by scenario, that isolates every mechanism’s contribution and confirms it earns its place in the reported accuracy; the results are gathered in Table III .
blocks.zh: 如第三节所述,拟议的两种方法都采用每曲线播种原则,但通过累积堆放机制追求不同的目标(粗糙的地面与细小的道路),每种方法都针对实际数据中观察到的具体故障。 与自主驾驶的安全重点一致,每一种机制都是为了提高底线(最坏情况情景)并倾向于精确度,这样行为才能在全场保持可预见性,避免灾难性故障[42]. 为了明确每个阶段的目的,我们对HySoLiD-Drive的100个标定框架进行了累积检查,这些框架按情景分类,孤立了每个机制的贡献,并证实了它在报告的准确性中的位置;结果见表三。

blocks.en: TABLE III: Cumulative Ablation of the Proposed Ground and Road Methods: IoU Evolution per Scenario.
blocks.zh: 表三:拟议地面和道路方法的累积变化:每个设想的IoU演变。

blocks.en: Regarding the ground method composition, Table III shows that the seeded region grow alone reaches 0.825 IoU with high recall (0.953) but modest precision (0.860), and is already stable across scenarios. The vertical-stack gate raises precision sharply, as intended, to 0.934 for only a 0.011 recall loss, improving IoU in every scenario without exception, as any vertical structure (pole, car, wall, or tree) now halts the ground growth immediately. The rank re-seed costs a negligible 0.002 IoU on average but restores recall to 0.954 by reclaiming ground beyond vertical breaks such as medians. Finally, the protrusion guard completes the method, trimming residual object skirts and gently rising surfaces to lift precision by a further 0.039, to 0.961, for a 0.023 recall trade. It benefits the ramp scenes the most (until then the hardest bucket by roughly ten points), which climb from 0.776 to 0.825 IoU, in line with the other scenarios at last.
blocks.zh: 关于地面方法的构成,表三显示,仅种子区域就增长到0.825个IoU,召回率高(0.953),但精度低(0.860),而且各种情况已经稳定。 纵架闸门将精确度按原计划大幅提升至0.934,仅差0.011回溯损失,无一例外地改进了每一种情景中的IoU,因为任何垂直结构(柱、车、墙或树)现在都立即停止了地面生长。 军衔重新播种平均成本可忽略不计的0.002 IoU,但通过在中位数等垂直断面以外开垦地面,恢复到0.954。 最后,螺旋桨护卫完成这个方法,将残余物体的裙子修剪,并轻轻地升起表面,以再提高0.039的精度,达到0.961,为0.023的召回贸易. 它最有利于坡道场景(直到当时最困难的桶子约10点),从0.776升至0.825,这终于符合其他情景。

blocks.en: The road segmentation chain tells a similar story. The center-seeded walk starts strong at 0.882 IoU but is markedly unbalanced: straights and mild curves reach around 0.95, whereas sharp turns fall to 0.633 and roundabouts to 0.813, because a single seed at the lateral center cannot follow a curving or branching road. Multiseed propagation equalizes this profile, trading a small drop on straights (to 0.938) for large gains where the road bends (roundabout to 0.880, sharp turn to 0.739), at the cost of making the system more prone to bleeding into non-road in difficult scenarios (crosswalk drops to 0.797). The curvature veto leaves IoU unchanged at 0.900 but shifts the precision–recall balance toward recall (from 0.937 to 0.946), suppressing the spurious break a curve’s concave apex would otherwise trigger, so the walk reaches further along bending roads. The step-cut then self-corrects curves that grow past the road edge, recovering the crosswalk bucket to 0.849 and lifting the overall IoU to 0.906. The internal heal is not an accuracy mechanism (it changes IoU by only − 0.001 -0.001 ) but a downstream-safety fill that closes false negatives and bald spots near the sensor that would otherwise be read as obstacles and trigger spurious emergency braking. Finally, the cohesion pass completes the method, raising the hardest scenes once more (sharp turn to 0.792) and bringing both precision (0.969) and IoU (0.907) to their peaks.
blocks.zh: 道路分割链讲述了类似的故事. 中种子行走开始强度为0.882IoU,但明显不平衡:直径和温和的曲线达到0.95左右,而尖锐的弯曲则跌至0.633,圆环则跌至0.813,因为横向中心的一个单一种子不能沿着曲折或分支的道路走. 多种子传播使这一特征相等,在道路弯曲(大约为0.880,锐变为0.739)时,用小幅直径下降(到0.938)换取大收益,代价是使系统在困难情况下更容易流血成非道路(横道下降为0.797)。 曲面否决让IoU在0.900不变,但将精确的-召回平衡转向召回(从0.937改为0.946),压制曲面的曲面顶端会触发,因此步行沿着弯曲的道路走得更远。 阶梯剪接后自行校正曲线逐渐越过路边,将横行木桶恢复到0.849,整体IoU提升到0.906. 内部愈合不是精确机制(它只改变−0.001-0.01),而是下游安全填充,关闭传感器附近的假底片和秃头斑点,否则会被视为障碍并触发假的紧急刹车。 最后,凝聚度传承完成方法,再次将最难的场景提升到0.792,使精度(0.969)和IoU(0.907)都达到峰值.

blocks.en: The ablation thus demonstrates that each mechanism earns its place: by targeting the weakest scenarios and favoring precision, the added stages equalize performance and keep the method predictable across driving situations.
blocks.zh: 由此可见,每个机制都有其地位:通过针对最弱的情景和倾向于精确,所增加的各个阶段均匀性能,并在整个驾驶情况下保持方法的可预测性。

blocks.en: V-D Qualitative Results and Limitations
blocks.zh: V-D 定性结果和限制

blocks.en: Figures 8a and 8b concern the ground method, shown in a 3-D perspective view so that object height and volume are visible. In Fig. 8a , the ego vehicle takes a sharp urban left turn past a parking entrance, a badly parked car, a fence, and leafy trees. In this scene, the vertical-stack and protrusion guards keep the ground correct almost everywhere, with false positives confined to the first one or two scan lines at the base of each rising object (tree trunks, wheels) before growth is halted. Figure 8b shows a motorway where the frontal view of the LiDAR is occluded by traffic. Here, our method recovers the occlusion gaps and, through re-seeding, the ground across the median on the left. This recovery is not free, however: a truck on the left and roadside vegetation on the right are wrongly seeded as ground, as they sit marginally below the grown ground height, and briefly mislabeled for several scan lines until the guards intervene.
blocks.zh: 图8a和图8b涉及三维视角显示的地面方法,以使物体高度和体积可见。 在图8a中,自负车左转尖锐,穿过一个停车入口,一个停车不便的汽车,一个栅栏和多叶的树木。 在这个场景中,垂直的植株和螺旋桨卫士几乎在任何地方都使地面正确,在生长停止前,每个上升物体(树干,轮子)的基部,将假阳性限制在第一两个扫描线上. 图8b显示的是一条车道,其中LiDAR前视线被交通堵塞. 在这里,我们的方法恢复了闭塞空隙,并通过重新播种,将地面穿过左边的中位数. 然而,这种恢复并不是免费的:一辆卡车在左边和路边的植被被错误地播种为地面,因为它们略低于已生长的地面高度,在警卫干预之前短暂地给几条扫描线贴上了错误的标签。

blocks.en: Figures 8c and 8d show the road method from a top view. Figure 8c illustrates why precision reaches 0.969: there are virtually no false positives even where only a low curb bounds the road, and both sides of the occlusion cast by a lead vehicle are seeded correctly. It also exposes the first limitation: beyond about 60 m the scan lines are around 10 m apart in range, and the propagation can no longer separate the road’s natural slope from a raised curb, so very distant curves are dropped as false negatives. Additionally, Fig. 8d shows the method’s principal limitation: at a crosswalk adapted with a gentle wheelchair-friendly ramp instead of a curb, the absence of a vertical boundary lets the road bleed sideways into false positives; the step-cut and cohesion pass contain most of it, but curves that cross the ramp directly cannot be distinguished from the road camber and are wrongly labeled as road together with a strip of sidewalk.
blocks.zh: 图8c和图8d从顶部视图显示道路方法。 图8c说明了精确度达到0.969的原因:即使路面只有低路面,几乎没有假阳性,铅载具所投放的隔离物的两侧都正确播种。 这也暴露了第一个限制:在60米以外,扫描线在范围上相距约10米,而且传播无法再将道路的自然坡度与上升的路面分隔开来,因此非常遥远的曲线被抛下作为假底片。 此外,图8d还显示了该方法的主要局限性:在采用温和的方便轮椅的坡道而不是路边的横道上,没有垂直的边界使得道路的侧面流血成假阳性;阶梯和凝聚度的通过包含大部分内容,但穿过坡道的曲线不能直接与道路凸轮区分开来,被错误地标为道路和一条人行道。

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en: The automotive industry is finally integrating LiDAR into production vehicles. However, the sensors it has chosen (hybrid solid-state and solid-state) differ by design from the spinning mechanical LiDARs behind today’s autonomous-driving research and public datasets. Hybrid solid-state LiDARs produce ring-free, dense, cluttered, front-facing data that challenges both the classical geometric pipelines and the learned methods built for those sensors. Yet, that same dense, focused, per-curve structure is also an opportunity, unlocking new solutions to autonomous-driving problems where the sparse data of spinning LiDAR falls short. Precise ground and road segmentation is one such problem. In hybrid solid-state data, the road boundary reveals itself through two clean geometric signatures: a height step and a range fold-back. GHySSeg exploits these signatures with a purely geometric pipeline, composed of a per-curve walk with seeded growth, multiseed propagation, and several guard mechanisms, to segment both ground and road from a single frame, with no training and no GPU, in real time.
blocks.zh: 汽车工业最终将LiDAR纳入生产车辆. 然而,它选择的传感器(hybrid固态和固态)在设计上不同于当今自主驾驶研究和公共数据集背后的旋转机械LiDARs. 混合固态LiDARs生成无环、密集、杂乱无章的前置数据,既挑战了古典几何管道,也挑战了为这些传感器开发的学习方法。 然而,同样的密集、集中、跨曲线结构也是一个机会,在旋转LiDAR的稀少数据不足的地方,打开了自主驾驶问题的新解决方案。 精确的地面和道路分割是此类问题之一。 在混合固态数据中,道路边界通过两个干净的几何特征来揭示自己:一个高度阶梯和一个射程折叠背. GHySSeg利用这些签名,用纯几何的管道,由带种子生长、多种子传播和若干警卫机制的每条曲线行走组成,将地面和道路从一个框架分割开来,没有经过训练,也没有GPU。

blocks.en: On the benchmark that had to be assembled for this work given the unavailability of hybrid solid-state benchmarks for ground and road segmentation, GHySSeg outperforms the state of the art on both tasks, ground and road segmentation, achieving 0.896 IoU at 0.961 precision for ground and 0.907 IoU at 0.969 precision for road, ahead of both leading geometric and non-retrained learned baselines, and comfortably so on road. Precision (the safety-critical metric the pipeline is built around) is the primary result, as it keeps real obstacles from being mislabeled as traversable, a failure that can be fatal. Furthermore, the method has proven to be transferable between vehicles and sensor poses under frozen parameters without accuracy loss. Just as important, the full ground-and-road pipeline runs at ∼ \sim 22 ms per frame on a single CPU core, well within the sensor’s 100 ms period, demonstrating its real-time, on-board capabilities and leaving ample headroom for downstream autonomous-driving modules.
blocks.zh: 由于缺乏地面和道路分割的混合固态基准,因此,GHySSeg在地面和道路分割这两个任务上都超过了最新水平,实现了0.896IoU的地面精确度为0.96,0.907IoU的公路精确度为0.969,领先于主要的几何和非再培训的学习基线,在公路上也是这样。 精度(管道围绕建造的安全关键衡量标准)是主要结果,因为它使真正的障碍不会被误贴为可穿越性,这种失败可能是致命的。 此外,事实证明,这种方法可在车辆和传感器在冻结参数下可转让,不会丧失准确性。 同样重要的是,完整的地面和公路管道在单个CPU核心上运行,每帧22 ms,远在传感器100 ms的时间内,展示其实时、机载能力,并为下游自动驾驶模块留下充足的头室。

blocks.en: Beyond the method, this work contributes a benchmark. We release HySoLiD-Drive (100 semantically labeled point clouds and 7000 unlabeled ones from two continuous drives, recorded by two vehicles that mount the same Seyond Falcon Kinetic LiDAR) as the first public benchmark dedicated to ground and road segmentation on an automotive hybrid solid-state LiDAR, with an open leaderboard and evaluation tools. It closes a real gap: while nearly every major public autonomous-driving dataset remains mechanical-centered, the industry moves toward solid-state sensing.
blocks.zh: 除了方法之外,这项工作还提供了基准。 我们释放了HySoLiD-Drive(100个标注点云和7000个无标注点云),它们来自两个连续驱动器,由两辆搭载同一架Seyond Falcon Kinetic LiDAR的车辆记录,是汽车混合固态LiDAR上第一个专门进行地面和道路分割的公共基准,具有开放的领导板和评价工具. 它填补了一个真正的空白:虽然几乎每个主要的公共自主驾驶数据集仍然以机械为中心,但工业却朝着固体状态感知的方向发展。

blocks.en: The thorough evaluation of the method also surfaced two honest, bounded limitations. Where no physical boundary (a curb, guardrail, or even a drainage channel) delimits the road, the method cannot stop growing and produces false positives; and beyond roughly 60 m, the non-uniform density of a front-facing solid-state sensor leaves far curves too sparse to classify, yielding false negatives. Future work targets both: the road-edge signatures can be complemented with the sensor’s native dense and robust intensity returns to detect painted lane markings where no other physical edge exists, and temporal multi-frame accumulation via LiDAR odometry can densify distant range to recover far road, trading the single-shot property for recall. Finally, as labeled hybrid or solid-state data from other sensors becomes publicly available, it would be interesting to explore how GHySSeg transfers to their different scan patterns and point distributions, extending the cross-vehicle generalization shown here to a cross-sensor setting.
blocks.zh: 对方法的彻底评价也显现出两个诚实的,有限度的限制. 在没有物理边界(控制线、护栏、甚至排水通道)划定道路的地方,该方法无法停止生长,产生假阳性;在大约60米以外,前立式固态传感器的非统一密度留下的曲线太少,无法分类,产生假阴性。 未来工作的目标既包括:对路边的标志可以辅之以传感器的本土密集和强强度的回报,在没有其他物理边缘的地方探测漆色的车道标志;通过LiDAR odometry的时间多帧积聚可以使远程变薄以恢复远程,将单发地物换取召回。 最后,随着其他传感器的标签混合或固态数据公开提供,探索GHySSeg如何向不同的扫描模式和点分布转移,将此处显示的交叉车辆泛化扩展至交叉传感器设置,将很有趣。
